script.hook: Budhvaar subah, office canteen mein Bhai ka phone lagataar baj raha hai.

scenes.label: SETUP

visual.prompt: BHAI in a hoodie sits in a busy office canteen in the morning, his phone buzzing nonstop on the table next to a cup of chai, curious excited face

scenes.vo: Budhvaar subah, office canteen mein Bhai ka phone lagataar baj raha hai.

scenes.label: SETUP

visual.prompt: Close-up of BHAI reading a group chat on his phone, eyes widening with excitement, bright morning light from the canteen window, a rocket doodle floating above the phone

scenes.vo: Group mein message aaya, Sensex udd raha hai, abhi ghuso. Sensex yaani desh ki badi companies ka score.

scenes.label: THE CHOICE

visual.prompt: Office colleagues crowded around several phones and a laptop, all screens glowing green with rising lines, people smiling and pointing, late morning

scenes.vo: Din ke beech Sensex lagbhag 829 points upar chala gaya tha. Har screen hari thi.

scenes.label: THE CHOICE

visual.prompt: BHAI standing apart from the crowd, chin in hand, feeling left out and impatient, colleagues cheering in the background

scenes.vo: Bhai ne socha, sab khareed rahe hain, toh main peeche kyun rahun.

scenes.label: THE CHOICE

visual.prompt: BHAI hurriedly tapping on his phone with one hand while holding a half-eaten lunch roti in the other, determined rushed expression, midday

scenes.vo: Logic seedha tha, jo upar ja raha hai, woh aur upar jayega. Lunch mein jaldi se order daal diya.

scenes.label: THE CHOICE

visual.prompt: BEHEN in office wear with arms crossed, sceptical raised eyebrow, asking a question; BHAI waving her off confidently, showing his phone, office corridor

scenes.vo: Behen ne poocha, badha kyun? Bhai bola, wajah chhodo, bas tezi dekho.

scenes.label: WHAT REALLY HAPPENED

visual.prompt: Afternoon office, the same group of colleagues now quiet and frowning at phone screens that are slowly turning from green to red, smiles fading

scenes.vo: Dopahar ke baad market palatne laga. Ek ek karke saari tezi gayab.

scenes.label: WHAT REALLY HAPPENED

visual.prompt: Evening, an office window with orange sunset, a single phone on a desk showing a red falling line, empty chairs around it

scenes.vo: Shaam ko Sensex 143 points neeche band hua. Upar nahi, neeche.

scenes.label: WHAT REALLY HAPPENED

visual.prompt: BHAI on a crowded evening bus home, staring at his phone glowing red in his hand, shoulders slumped, regretful face

scenes.vo: Bhai ne sabse oonche daam par entry li thi. Ab uski screen laal thi.

scenes.label: THE TWIST

visual.prompt: SG in a striped shirt sitting at a dinner table at night, calmly explaining with an open hand, BHAI listening with his phone face down beside his plate

scenes.vo: Twist yeh hai, ek din ki tezi sirf khabar hai, plan nahi. Market din bhar mood badalta hai.

scenes.label: THE TWIST

visual.prompt: BHAI at night switching off notifications on his phone and writing goals in a small notebook on the dinner table, calm thoughtful expression, warm lamp light

scenes.vo: Group ka shor nahi, apna goal dekh kar chalo. Yeh investment advice nahi hai.

scenes.vo: Aapne kabhi tezi dekh kar jaldi mein khareeda hai? Haan ya na?
